meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为仓库生成分层的 AGENTS.md 文档,把目录结构、常用命令与编码约定写清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常接手陌生代码库,想让 AI 助手一进项目就摸清结构。
copy.tagline_en: Write layered AGENTS.md so AI assistants learn a repo's structure and commands.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often pick up unfamiliar repos and want AI to know them fast.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为项目生成分层的 AGENTS.md 知识库:根目录一份,外加按复杂度评分选出的子目录各一份,内容涵盖结构、命令、约定与反模式,由扫描节点和写入节点分工产出。
howto.when: 当仓库需要把结构、命令、约定等记录给 agent 用时触发。用 /init-deep 调用,可加 --create-new 等参数,目录深度默认 3。

say.text: /init-deep 给这个仓库建 AGENTS.md 知识库
say.note: 扫描仓库并生成分层文件
先读现有文件,删除后重建

howto.what_en: After install, Claude builds a layered AGENTS.md knowledge base for a repo: a root file plus files for complexity-scored subdirectories, covering structure, commands, conventions and anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo needs its structure, commands and conventions documented for agents. Invoke it with /init-deep, optionally with flags such as --create-new.

say_en.text: /init-deep build the AGENTS.md knowledge base for this repo
say_en.note: Scans the repo and writes the files
